contentEn:
A whole-house renovation in Vancouver in 2026 typically costs $85–$250 per square foot for mid-range work and $250–$500+ per square foot for premium finishes, with most complete home renovations falling between $120,000 and $450,000 depending on scope, Vancouver permit fees, and material selections. Reno Stars has completed whole-house renovation projects across Delta, Richmond, and North Vancouver, with costs confirmed against real contracts in each city.

What Does a Whole-House Renovation Include in Vancouver?

A whole-house renovation means your entire home — or a full floor — gets updated simultaneously. In Vancouver's older housing stock (1980s–1990s ranches and split-levels in Surrey, Burnaby, and Coquitlam), this typically covers the kitchen, all bathrooms, flooring, electrical updates, and exterior finishes. A mid-range whole-house renovation for a 2,000 sq ft home in Metro Vancouver costs $240,000–$500,000 in 2026, while premium renovations with high-end finishes exceed $600,000.

Reno Stars managed a whole-house renovation in Delta that included a new kitchen, two full bathrooms, and flooring throughout — a scope that illustrates the real cost structure for Metro Vancouver homeowners.

Whole-House Renovation Cost by Size in Vancouver (2026)

Cost estimates for whole-house renovations in Vancouver vary most by square footage. Based on Reno Stars' confirmed project data across Metro Vancouver:

  • 1,000 sq ft home: $120,000–$200,000 (mid-range)
  • 1,500 sq ft home: $180,000–$325,000 (mid-range)
  • 2,000 sq ft home: $240,000–$450,000 (mid-range)
  • 2,500+ sq ft home: $300,000–$600,000+ (mid-range)

These ranges include demolition, structural updates where needed, new electrical wiring to current code, plumbing modifications, drywall, finishing, and GST. They exclude landscape and HVAC upgrades.

Kitchen and Bathroom: The Two Biggest Tickets in a Whole-House Reno

In any whole-house renovation in Vancouver, the kitchen and bathrooms consume 60–70% of the total budget. A mid-range kitchen renovation in Vancouver costs $35,000–$85,000; a mid-range bathroom costs $18,000–$40,000. Reno Stars' Richmond whole-house project — which covered one kitchen, two bathrooms, and full flooring — illustrates how these costs stack in practice.

What Adds the Most Cost in a Vancouver Whole-House Reno?

The highest-cost scope items that surprise Vancouver homeowners are structural changes (removing load-bearing walls), full electrical rewiring to meet current BC Electrical Code, plumbing re-piping in homes with aging Poly-B pipes, and any work requiring a City of Vancouver building permit. Permit fees in Vancouver proper for a whole-house renovation run $3,000–$12,000 depending on the scope declared.

  • Load-bearing wall removal: $5,000–$25,000
  • Full electrical rewire: $8,000–$30,000
  • Plumbing re-pipe (Poly-B replacement): $3,000–$15,000
  • Vancouver building permit: $3,000–$12,000

How Long Does a Whole-House Renovation Take in Vancouver?

A complete whole-house renovation in Vancouver takes 4–10 months from permit approval to handover. Homes in Richmond, Surrey, and Burnaby with pre-1990 construction may encounter unexpected structural or electrical issues that add 3–6 weeks. Reno Stars provides a detailed project timeline before signing a contract, with milestones at demolition, rough-in, insulation, drywall, and final inspection.

Whole-House Renovation Cost FAQ — Vancouver 2026

Is $100,000 enough for a whole-house renovation in Vancouver in 2026?

A $100,000 budget in Vancouver in 2026 covers a partial renovation — typically one kitchen OR two bathrooms with flooring — but not a true whole-house renovation. For a complete home update on a 1,500 sq ft home, realistic budgets start at $180,000 for mid-range finishes.

Does a whole-house renovation in Vancouver require a building permit?

Yes. Any whole-house renovation in Vancouver involving structural changes, electrical rewiring, or plumbing modifications requires a City of Vancouver building permit. Minor cosmetic updates (paint, flooring, fixture replacement) may not. Reno Stars handles the permit application as part of its project management service.

Does BC GST apply to whole-house renovation costs in Vancouver?

Yes. All renovation work in BC is subject to GST (5%). Budget an additional 5% on top of all contractor quotes. If your whole-house renovation is for a rental property, you may be able to claim input tax credits — ask your accountant.

Should I do the whole house at once or one room at a time?

Doing the whole house at once is cheaper per square foot (one demobilization/remobilization, one inspection cycle) and faster overall. Staggering renovations spreads cash flow but typically adds 20–30% to total cost due to repeated setup. Reno Stars recommends a single contract for the full scope where homeowners have the budget to proceed.

Does homeowners insurance cover a whole-house renovation in Vancouver?

Standard Vancouver home insurance covers damage restoration (fire, water, seismic) but does not cover elective renovation. If your whole-house renovation is triggered by an insurable event — a fire, flood, or covered water damage — your insurer may cover the restoration portion of the work. Renovations triggered by age, wear, or style are not covered.

温哥华2026年整体房屋装修通常每平方英尺费用在85至250加元之间（中档装修），高档装修则在250至500加元以上。大多数完整房屋装修工程费用在12万至45万加元之间，具体取决于施工范围、许可证费用及材料选择。

温哥华整体房屋装修包含哪些项目？

整体房屋装修意味着您的整个房屋或整个楼层同时进行翻新。温哥华地区（如素里、伯纳比和高贵林的1980至1990年代平房和错层式住宅）的典型装修范围包括厨房、所有浴室、地板更新、电路升级和外墙处理。卑诗省大温哥华地区2,000平方英尺房屋的中档整体装修费用在2026年达到24万至50万加元，而高档装修费用则超过60万加元。

温哥华按房屋面积的整体装修费用（2026年）

  • 1,000平方英尺房屋：12万至20万加元（中档）
  • 1,500平方英尺房屋：18万至32.5万加元（中档）
  • 2,000平方英尺房屋：24万至45万加元（中档）
  • 2,500平方英尺以上房屋：30万至60万加元以上（中档）

这些费用包括拆除、结构加固（如需要）、新布线、管道修改，干墙、装修和GST。景观和暖通空调升级不包括在内。

厨房和浴室：整体装修中的两大费用项目

温哥华任何整体房屋装修中，厨房和浴室占总预算的60%至70%。温哥华中档厨房装修费用在3.5万至8.5万加元之间；中档浴室装修在1.8万至4万加元之间。Reno Stars在列治文的整体装修项目——涵盖一间厨房、两间浴室和全屋地板——说明了这些费用在实际中的叠加方式。

温哥华整体装修中哪些项目费用最高？

  • 承重墙拆除：5,000至25,000加元
  • 全屋电路改造：8,000至30,000加元
  • 管道更换（Poly-B管）：3,000至15,000加元
  • 温哥华建筑许可证：3,000至12,000加元

温哥华整体装修需要多长时间？

温哥华整体房屋装修从许可证批准到交房需要4至10个月。列治文、素里和伯纳比1990年前建造的房屋可能遇到意外的结构或电气问题，增加3至6周时间。
